instruction: You begin looking at a picture hung on a white wall. Turn around to your left, you should see a zebra skin rug. It is in very poor condition, just step on its head. That'll show that herbivorous equine what's what. Continue out of the door that is open in front of you. Once out there continue down the hallway to the left, past the L-shaped blue couch, and jump over the brown-orange chair on the right, heading towards the porch. Once you are out on the porch just step forward onto the walkway behind the lounging chairs in front of you, and once you are behind the chair on the left, the first one you'll come to, you are done.
